dc_tss.title: Traffic Safety Statistics Report for the District of Columbia (2015-2017), draft (HUTRC for DDOT)

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: DDOT prints no crash costs; it cites FHWA's published national costs (TSS 2015-2017 p. 5). National costs aren't used for DC without the user's decision

statewide_rates.missing: DDOT publishes no average rates by facility type (research 2026-11-07), and CrashIQ has no DC traffic counts

screening.state_method: ranked lists by frequency, rate, severity cost and trend combined in a Composite Crash Index (TSS 2015-2017; research 2026-11-07)

min_years.missing: not recorded in the research notes (2026-11-07)
